 %% Styling
 classDef x11 fill:#1a1a1a,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff;
 classDef core fill:#0d0d0d,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:2px,color:#ff0000;
 classDef inner fill:#260000,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:1px,color:#ffffff;
 classDef ext fill:#1a1a1a,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff;

 X11[X11 Display Server / Xorg]:::x11

 subgraph coreWM [core_WM - Rust Engine]
 Backend[X11 Backend<br/>x11rb / xcb-rs]:::inner
 EventLoop[Event Loop Manager<br/>Wait & Poll Events]:::inner
 State[Window State & Tree<br/>Layout, Canvas, Focus]:::inner
 KeyHandler[Keybinding & Command<br/>Dispatcher]:::inner
 end

 AGS[Custom AGS Shell / TUI<br/>Power Menu, Bar, Status]:::ext
 Clients[Managed Windows / Apps<br/>Kitty, Qutebrowser, etc.]:::ext

 Backend -->|Parsed Events| EventLoop
 EventLoop -->|Map / Unmap / Motion| State
 EventLoop -->|KeyPress Events| KeyHandler
 KeyHandler -->|Exec IPC / Scripts| AGS
 State -->|Configure & Render| Clients

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as App / User
 participant X as X11 Server
 participant WM as core_WM (Rust)
 participant State as Window State Tree

 User->>X: Launch Application (e.g. Kitty)
 X->>WM: MapRequest Event
 activate WM
 WM->>State: Query attributes & register window
 activate State
 State-->>WM: Return position (Canvas / Tiling coordinates)
 deactivate State
 WM->>X: xcb::map_window()
 WM->>X: xcb::configure_window() (Apply borders / geometry)
 X-->>User: Render window on screen
 deactivate WM",
 "config": null
